name: com.sobot.callbase.widget.floatwindow.FloatActivity
description: Sobot CallBase, used by the Sobot customer-service call SDK, opens Android’s overlay-access settings when the call flow requests permission for a floating call window. After the user returns, it reports whether permission was granted.
disableEffect: Without this screen, users cannot grant overlay access through the SDK, so its floating incoming or ongoing call window may not appear.
